'''Creative Surgery - The Cutting Edge''' was a shop<ref name="db">{{DB|character|doctorevazan|Evazan, Doctor}}</ref> on [[Truuzdann]]<ref name="ff">{{FactFile|51|CAN 11-14|Mos Eisley Cantina Characters}}</ref> in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] owned by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]]. Sometime before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jodo Kast]] tracked Evazan down to his shop.<ref name="db" />
